questions.question: Where is the deepest point on earth, the Mariana Trench, located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pacific Ocean**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Mariana Trench,** which is the deepest point on earth, is located in the **Pacific Ocean**.
 
• It is situated in the western Pacific Ocean, to the east of the Mariana Islands.
 
• The Mariana Trench is approximately 2,550 km long and 69 km wide, with a depth of 10,994 meters at its deepest point, known as the Challenger Deep.
 
• The trench is formed by the collision of the Pacific Plate and the Philippine Plate, which creates a subduction zone and leads to the formation of the deepest part of the ocean floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• **Atlantic Ocean - **

 
 
• This is incorrect because the Atlantic Ocean, while vast and home to significant depths, does not contain the deepest point on Earth.
 
• Its deepest point is the Milwaukee Deep (Puerto Rico Trench), which is approximately 8,376 meters (27,480 feet) deep, far shallower compared to the Mariana Trench.
 
 
 
• **Indian Ocean -**
 
 
• This option is not correct. The Indian Ocean's deepest point is the Java Trench (also known as the Sunda Trench), with a maximum depth of about 7,725 meters (25,344 feet), making it much shallower than the Mariana Trench.
 
 
 
• **Arctic Ocean -**
 
 
• This is also incorrect. The Arctic Ocean's deepest point is the Molloy Deep in the Fram Strait, with a depth of about 5,550 meters (18,209 feet).
 
• While fascinating for its own ecological and geographical characteristics, it does not compare to the depth of the Mariana Trench.
 
 

 

Thus, the Mariana Trench's extreme depth and unique ecosystem have made it a subject of much scientific research and interest, emphasizing its significance located in the Pacific Ocean.

questions.question: In which of the following states is the Brihadeswara Temple, the world’s first temple built from granite, located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brihadeswara Temple, the world’s first temple built from granite, located in Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Brihadishvara temple**

 
 
• **Brihadishvara temple also called Rajarajeswaram **is a Hindu temple.
 
• **Temple dedicated to Shiva** located on the **South Bank of the Kaveri river in Thanjavur,** Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It is one of the largest South Indian temples and an exemplary example of fully realized Tamil architecture.
 
• It is called** Dhakshina Meru (Meru of the south)**.
 
• **Built by Tamil king Raja Raja Chola I **between 1003 and 1010 AD.
 
• The temple is a part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site known as the "**Great Living Chola Temples**", along with the Chola dynasty era Gangaikonda Cholapuram temple and Airavatesvara temple.

questions.question: Which state police force in India recently launched 'NARIT AI', an Artificial Intelligence-based tool designed to strengthen narcotics investigations and improve conviction rates?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat Police**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Gujarat Police** has launched an **AI-based tool** named **NARIT AI** (Narcotics Analysis and RAG-based Investigation Tool) to assist in narcotics case investigations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **NARIT AI:** This is the **first AI-based investigation tool** of its kind being used by any state police or law enforcement agency in India.
 
• **Purpose:** It is designed to assist investigating officers in dealing with cases under the **Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985**, by providing real-time legal analysis and procedural guidance.
 
• **Functionality:** Built on **Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)** technology, the tool analyses **First Information Reports (FIRs)** to generate reports assessing the strengths and weaknesses of a case, helping avoid procedural lapses that often lead to acquittals.
 
• **Gujarat Police** launched this tool in **Gandhinagar** as part of the state’s zero-tolerance approach toward drug-related crimes. Hence, Option 1 is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Development:** The application was developed by the **Western Railway Police** in the **Vadodara division** in collaboration with a **Mumbai-based AI startup**.
 
• **Leadership:** The project was led by Western Railway Vadodara **SP Abhay Soni** under the guidance of **DGP Dr K. L. N. Rao** and Surat City Police Commissioner **Anupam Singh Gehlot**.
 
• **Training Data:** The system is trained on **landmark judgments** of the **High Courts** and the **Supreme Court**, as well as the **NDPS Act**, and the bare acts of **BNS, BNSS, and BSA**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Private AI System:** The tool operates on a **closed database** and does not rely on open internet searches, which significantly reduces the likelihood of **hallucination** (inaccurate outputs).
 
• **Force Multiplier:** By automating the analysis of complex legal provisions, the tool acts as a **force multiplier**, empowering every investigating officer to conduct scientific and rule-compliant investigations.

questions.question: The sister of Harshavardhana Rajyashri was married to__________, the king of Maukhari dynasty of Kanyakubja.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Grahavarman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajyashri, the sister of Harshavardhana, was married to Grahavarman.
 
• Grahavarman was the king of the Maukhari dynasty, which ruled over Kanyakubja (modern-day Kannauj).
 
• The Maukhari dynasty played a significant role in the political landscape of northern India during the early medieval period.
 
• The marriage alliance between Rajyashri and Grahavarman helped strengthen the political ties between the Vardhana dynasty and the Maukhari dynasty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harshavardhana**

 
 
• Harshavardhana, also known as Harsha, was a prominent Indian emperor who ruled North India from 606 to 647 CE.
 
• He belonged to the Vardhana dynasty and was known for his efforts to establish a strong and unified empire in northern India.
 
• Harsha was a patron of arts and culture, and his court was adorned with scholars like Banabhatta and Xuanzang.
 
• His reign marked a period of prosperity and cultural flourishing in North India.
 
 
 
• **Maukhari Dynasty**
 
 
• The Maukhari dynasty was an influential ruling dynasty in North India during the 6th and 7th centuries CE.
 
• They initially served as vassals of the Gupta Empire before establishing their independent rule.
 
• The Maukhari rulers were known for their administrative efficiency and military prowess.
 
• Their capital was Kanyakubja (Kannauj), which became a significant center of power in North India.
 
 
 
• **Kanyakubja (Kannauj)**
 
 
• Kanyakubja, also known as Kannauj, is an ancient city located in the present-day Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It has been a prominent political, cultural, and commercial center since ancient times.
 
• Kannauj was known for its rich cultural heritage and was a major center of learning and arts.
 
• Throughout history, Kannauj has been a coveted seat of power for various dynasties, including the Maukhari and the Vardhana dynasties.
 
 
 
• **Political Alliances in Ancient India**
 
 
• Marriage alliances were a common strategy for establishing political ties and securing peace between different dynasties.
 
• Such alliances helped in strengthening mutual trust and cooperation between ruling families.
 
• They played a crucial role in the consolidation of power and expansion of empires in ancient India.
 
• These alliances also facilitated cultural exchange and integration between different regions.

questions.question: The Lucknow Pact was signed in ______ by Congress and the Muslim League to work in alliance for representative government.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1916**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Lucknow Pact,** signed in** December 1916, **marked a significant milestone in Indian politics, as it brought together the **Indian National Congress (INC) **and the** All India Muslim League **in a unified demand for Indian autonomy.
 
• Led by** Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Muhammad Ali Jinnah** respectively, the **Congress and Muslim League** passed the pact on **December 29 and 31, 1916.**
 
• This historic agreement showcased Hindu-Muslim unity, representing the first joint demand for political reform from both communities to the British colonial authorities.
 
• The Lucknow Pact instilled a sense of hope and possibility for achieving Home Rule (self-government) in British India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The pact facilitated cooperation between the 'extremist' faction, represented by leaders like **Lal Lajpat Rai, Bal Gangadhar Tilak, and Bipin Chandra Pal,** and the 'moderate' faction, initially led by **Gopal Krishna Gokhale and later by Mahatma Gandhi **within the Indian National Congress.
 
• Overall, the Lucknow Pact remains a pivotal moment in India's struggle for independence, emphasizing unity and cooperation among diverse political factions in the pursuit of self-governance.

questions.question: Which of the following is the least populous state of India as per 2011 census?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** is the least populous state in India as per the 2011 census.
 
• It has a population of approximately **610,577** people.
 
• Sikkim is known for its biodiversity and is situated in the northeastern part of India.
 
• The state is bordered by Bhutan, Tibet, and Nepal, and is characterized by mountainous terrain.
 
• Despite its small population, Sikkim has a high literacy rate and is known for its environmental conservation efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2011 Census** is the 15th National Census survey conducted by the Census Organization of India.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on demographic, social, and economic parameters of the population.
 
• The census is conducted every 10 years and is a crucial tool for planning and policy-making by the government.
 
• According to the 2011 Census, the total population of India was approximately **1.21 billion**.
 
• States like **Uttar Pradesh** and **Maharashtra** are among the most populous, while Sikkim and **Mizoram** are among the least populous.
 
• Data from the census is used to allocate resources, plan for infrastructure, and implement social programs.
